name: Simon
source:
A free-spirited, easygoing youth. Although one of the Wither Elves who have broken their link with nature, Simon loves nature and lives a solitary life as a Ranger in the deep woods. He becomes a member of the adventurers guild because of circumstances.

Simon isn't comfortable in cities or crowded places but for some reason he feels at ease in the Amakakeru Oyou public house. He executes his work smartly, but takes care to never reveal his inner thoughts.

[Spoiler] City-born but more at ease with the forest, Simon prefers the company of animals over that of sentient beings. He likes Lusit's cooking, so frequently brings prey he hunts to the public house for cooking. In return he gets free food and drink for bringing in the raw materials.

He is extremely knowledgeable of the wooded environs surrounding Dantor, and is the expert to turn to if there are guild commissions relating to the outdoors. 

He is friends with a wolf bearing a golden pelt. This eventually saves him, Edgar and the noble who sought the pelt for his collection at the cost of his friendship. The experience eventually taught him that living things should seek company with their own kind, instead of living alone or with fellow loners of different species. [/Spoiler]
